claims.title: Uniform conditioned-Poisson inference: exact rare-class tails and precision interfaces

quoted_fields.interface: Any fixed weakly reversible reaction structure, positive rational activity vector lambda, initial population x0 in its actual class Gamma, and rational 0<epsilon<1. W_lambda(x)=product lambda_i^x_i/x_i!, with Z_Gamma>=W_lambda(x0)>0 and total unrestricted mass exp(sum lambda_i). Classes may be finite or infinite. Tail truncation retains original reachability; it never substitutes connectivity inside the cutoff cube. The higher-Stirling interface is for positive real t with t>=8r. Equilibrium realization chooses rates from cycle circulation; it is not a claim about arbitrary original unbalanced rates.
